# WhatsClean 1.1.1
## Auto (7d) fixes
- Fixed Auto (7d) waiting up to 24 hours before its first cleanup after being enabled or restored following an app update. - Automatic cleanup now runs once immediately when its LaunchAgent is loaded, then continues every 24 hours. - Fixed the enabled Auto (7d) button appearing gray even though its status said ON. - The active state now uses an explicit green style that remains visually clear across macOS appearances. - Updated the confirmation text to explain that the first eligible cleanup starts immediately.

# WhatsClean 1.1.0
## Welcome and localization
- Added a concise first-launch welcome screen explaining how WhatsClean works. - Added complete English and Brazilian Portuguese resources; WhatsClean follows the preferred language configured in macOS and falls back to English. - Added a reusable **Getting Started** guide under Settings, the app menu, and the menu bar icon.
## About and transparency
- Added a dedicated, resizable **About WhatsClean** window. - Clarified that WhatsClean does not need to stay open or continuously run in the background. - Explained that Auto (7d) uses a lightweight macOS scheduled task to move WhatsApp media older than seven days to the Trash once a day. - Added clear privacy, open-source, GitHub, and license information.
## Discoverability and build reliability
- Improved project and installation descriptions for GitHub, Homebrew, and search engines. - Added a lightweight public project page with software metadata and installation links. - Made legacy icon packaging reproducible while retaining the modern macOS Tahoe asset catalog.

# WhatsClean 1.0.4
## Bug fix
- Fixed automatic update checks not running immediately when WhatsClean was reopened. - When **Automatically check for updates** is enabled, WhatsClean now performs a silent update check at launch. - No “up to date” dialog is shown for automatic background checks; update alerts appear only when a new version is available. - Manual **Check for Updates Now** behavior remains unchanged.
